purpose: Map CT10 on a dedicated property-only source route. The case executes parse, elaborate, footprint lowering, and the unedited DisjointFootprintsV1 check. Mapping grows the denominator; it is not a conformance claim.
derivation_rule: The verified stage block is the manifest row independently rederived by compiler/tests/ct_corpus.rs from its own dispatch and the case artifact.
what_the_mapping_claims: Two actual spawn write captures target adjacent bit-fields declared in one storage unit. On the explicit successful-spawn/join-window premise, the source lowering derives BitfieldUnit footprints and the checker refuses Q661 SharedBitfieldUnit. Ordinary disjoint fields and bit-fields in distinct units are admitted controls.
what_the_mapping_does_not_claim: No scoped-task ledger or failure-path custody proof, no C emission, no reference or native execution, no sanitizer evidence, and no case-bound proof stage. Declared target layout and Rust-to-Lean correspondence remain premises.
